name: Phrozen
summary: Resin- and FDM-printer maker whose filament line (High-Speed PLA launched with the ARCO printer, Tough PLA, PLA+/Rapid PLA+, PLA Matte, PLA Bronze) sells at $18-23/kg. Retailer part numbers suggest the PLA Matte line is Elegoo-made; other lines' maker is unknown.

oem_relationships.notes: PLA Matte only. Retailer aio.lv lists 'Phrozen PLA Matte' with MPNs 50.203.0250 (black) and 50.203.0251 (white), and one aio.lv title reads 'PLA Matte Filament Phrozen - ELEGOO Black'. These are Elegoo's own PLA Matte part numbers: 3DJake's Elegoo page reads 'Manufacturer No.: 50.203.0251 Manufacturer: Elegoo' (read 2026-11-06). aio.lv still returns 403 to every fetch, so the Phrozen side rests on search-result titles. No official statement.

Phrozen's Amazon account is the seller of record for Spider Maker nylon-CF and SpiderFlex TPU listings (seller details in additional_notes). Whether Phrozen owns the brand or only resells it is not stated; see the spider-maker entry.

product_lines.name: High-Speed PLA
product_lines.notes: 8 colours, $22.99; launched alongside the ARCO FDM printer; maker not identified.

product_lines.name: PLA+ / Rapid PLA+
product_lines.notes: 'Rapid' may indicate a high-flow grade; not confirmed, so pla-hf is not asserted.

product_lines.name: PLA Bronze
product_lines.notes: Unclear whether metal-filled or a colour/silk effect, so pla-metal is not asserted.

additional_notes: Legal entity (Phrozen Technology Co., Ltd.) and HQ (Hsinchu, Taiwan) are from background knowledge and were not verified from a source this session, so headquarters_country is omitted pending confirmation. SpoolmanDB PR #416 contains a single PLA entry. The Amazon brand 'SPIDER MAKER' (nylon carbon-fibre filament) is sold by the seller 'Phrozen 3D Printer' (id A34XNOS9PNSJKJ, Business Name 'PHROZEN TECH CO., LTD.', Hsinchu, Taiwan; read 2026-11-06). Phrozen is the seller of record; whether it owns the Spider Maker brand or resells it is not stated.

provenance.conflicts: Elegoo link covers the Matte line only; Elegoo's part numbers are confirmed (3DJake), the Phrozen listings under the same numbers are search-result titles only (aio.lv 403, re-checked 2026-11-06). Corporate identity/HQ unverified. Manufacturing country unknown.
